purpose: This list: every machine-readable file on the site with its purpose and cadence.
schema: { generated, license, files: [{ path, url, purpose, schema, cadence, media_type }] }

purpose: The site for AI readers: one summary and every page with a one-line description (llms.txt convention).
schema: Markdown: H1, blockquote summary, H2 sections of links.

purpose: The full text of every page, concatenated, generated from the same sources as the HTML.
schema: Markdown: one H1 per page with its source URL.

purpose: The live coordination ledger: every item with owner, status, done-when, evidence notes and timestamps.
schema: { built_utc, ledger_written_utc, items: [{ id, opened_utc, owner, owner_kind, status, item, done_when, notes[], updated_utc, stream, age_s }], pulse: [{ key, value }] }
cadence: whenever the ledger changes, at most hourly

purpose: Atom feed of settled ledger lines (done or dropped) with their evidence, newest first.
schema: Atom 1.0
cadence: whenever the ledger changes, at most hourly

purpose: The five real machines, what runs on each today, and every measured speed beside its physical ceiling, each with a receipt link.
schema: { as_of, source, judging, ceilings: [{ id, model, machine, tok_s, how, link, receipt, branch, on_main }], machines: [{ id, name, detail, role, today, evidence_date, evidence, link, branch, on_main, more[] }], speeds: [...] }
cadence: when a new receipt is published

purpose: What Omega is: its parts, every CUDA piece with Omega's replacement and status, the live no-CUDA receipt, what is not true yet, and the bar C1 to C6, each with its GitHub link.
schema: { source, claim, claim_rest[], true_today, not_true_yet, parts[], below, layers: [{ cuda, job, omega, status, note, links, box }], receipt, not_yet[], bar: [{ id, title, done_when, status, now, receipt, links }], beyond[] }; links are short forms (o: omega file, o/: omega folder, p: physics) expanded as on /omega/
cadence: when a bar row or map row changes

purpose: CUDA++: what it is for, every step from program to chip with whose code runs there and its status, how I did it, CUDA's pain points and the swap, each with its GitHub link.
schema: { source, claim, claim_rest[], purpose_title, purpose, hops: [{ step, cuda, ours, status, note, ledger, links, box }], steps[], did_not[], pains: [{ title, text, status, ledger, command, receipt, links, box }], swaps[] }; links are short forms (cp: CUDA++ main, cp@: CUDA++ at a commit, om@: omega at a commit) expanded as on /cudaplusplus/
cadence: when a step or row changes

purpose: The public GitHub record read at build time: components, last merges, open PR counts, latest decision records, latest verification receipt.
schema: { generated_at, components: [{ key, name, repo, role, url, pushed_at, open_prs, last_merge }], decisions: [{ id, title, url }], receipt: { repo, sha, state, description, target_url, updated_at } }

purpose: The status of every layer of the stack (IMPLEMENTED, QUALIFIED, EXPERIMENTAL, BLOCKED, PLANNED) with a note and a receipt.
schema: { project, updated, canonical, statuses[], layers: [{ name, status, note, receipt }] }

purpose: The research ladder: every experiment with its verdict, receipt and limits; the one source for every status badge on the site.
schema: { ladder, experiments, implementations, ... } as rendered on /research/status/

purpose: Retained public history of every project repository: source lines, revisions, PRs, CI runs over time.
schema: { asof, repos: [...], series: [...], events: [...], policy }

purpose: The line-preserving public ledger projection with private paths and identifiers withheld.
schema: Columns: id, opened_utc, owner, status, item, done_when, evidence, updated_utc.
cadence: whenever a safe ledger projection is accepted

purpose: Model quota left on every account the agents run on, as the Spark read it. Accounts are numbered; no email or account id is published.
schema: checked, utc; then limit, provider, account, plan, window, label, percent used, resets utc, ok|exhausted.
cadence: with the ledger, at most every 30 minutes on its own

purpose: Which model each omp role, subagent and advisor seat uses on the Spark.
schema: role|agent|seat, name, model selector.

purpose: Atom feed of the blog posts and research papers, newest first.
schema: Atom 1.0
cadence: when a page is published or revised

purpose: Every page, both languages, with lastmod and hreflang alternates. Walked from the files actually written.
schema: sitemaps.org 0.9 with xhtml:link alternates

purpose: The readable twin of sitemap.xml: every page grouped in H2 sections with a one-line description.
schema: Markdown: H1, blockquote summary, H2 sections of links.

purpose: The repository brief for coding agents: installation, configuration, usage, conventions and approval boundaries.
schema: Markdown: H1, Installation, Configuration, Usage, Conventions, Safety and approvals.
cadence: when the build or conventions change

purpose: The working rules every AIEN agent follows, public edition: read first by any agent working on an aien-dev repository, before that repository's own AGENTS.md.
schema: Markdown: H1, blockquote scope, numbered H2 sections, Where to go next.

purpose: Every public, unarchived aien-dev repository with its description, default branch and the agent brief it carries (AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md).
schema: { generated_at, org, repos: [{ name, description, url, default_branch, fork, pushed_at, brief }] }; brief is null when the repository has none

purpose: The front page as Markdown: the same content as the HTML, with frontmatter, the page body and a sitemap section. Every page has a mirror at the same path with .md.
schema: Markdown: YAML frontmatter (title, description, last_updated, canonical_url), body, Sitemap section.

purpose: Citation metadata for the Turing preprints.
schema: Citation File Format 1.2.0

purpose: The ratified V3 research plan in Markdown.
schema: Markdown

purpose: Who builds this: the person, the agents and the machines.
schema: humanstxt.org

purpose: Every crawler and AI agent is allowed everywhere; points at the sitemap.
schema: robots.txt

purpose: Canonical English page registry for live catalog consumers.
schema: [{path,title,description,area}]

purpose: The complete migrated engineer page record, including source provenance, old paths and full authored bodies.
schema: {source,note,pages:[{path,old,name,title,description,kind,body_html}]}
